name: White ceramic frit (RAL 9010 enamel fired over the whole face)

diffuseAlbedo.source: Workings/fritted.json: optics.whiteFullCoverage.luminousReflectanceGlassSide (0.572; Wilson and Elstner 2018, a 620 mm integrating sphere)
diffuseAlbedo.note: Seen through the glass, as the Atrium's frit is from the room. Only the luminous value was read, so it is neutral; the frit side reflects 0.623.

refractiveIndex.source: Workings/fritted.json: process (an enamel is a glass flux fired onto the float); a soda-lime glass's index stands for it
refractiveIndex.note: The face the eye meets is the glass's; the enamel's own index is not read.

porosity.source: a fired enamel is fused to the glass
porosity.derivation: a fused glass has no open pores

wettingDepth.source: a fired enamel is fused to the glass

transmittance.source: Workings/fritted.json: optics.whiteFullCoverage.luminousTransmittance (0.32, normal-hemispherical, EN 410; Wilson and Elstner 2018)
transmittance.note: All of it diffuse: a white frit passes almost no image-forming light. Only the luminous value was read, so it is neutral.
